meta: Freelance designers use AI to write quotes and lock the scope, so clients stop asking for endless revisions.

muc.title: Endless revisions
muc.text: Freelance designers get endless revision requests because the scope wasn't written down when they took the job.

muc.title: Spell everything out
muc.text: Tell a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, the client's request and ask it to list deliverables, number of revisions and deadline.

muc.title: Three packages to choose from
muc.text: Ask AI to split the quote into three packages: basic, standard, full. You set the prices based on your effort.

muc.title: Extra work, extra fee
muc.text: When the client asks for more, ask AI to draft a polite reply saying it's outside the agreement and costs extra.

muc.title: A scope sheet
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to draft a scope sheet for a logo design job, then send it to the client to confirm.
